gloss: to press for answers; to pursue (responsibility); to hold accountable

definitions.gloss: to press for answers; to pursue responsibility; to hold accountable; to question closely
definitions.explanation: To persistently question or investigate someone to uncover the truth or assign blame. Commonly used in political, journalistic, and legal contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追及|ついきゅう}する。
⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追及|ついきゅう}した。
examples.english: The opposition party pressed the government on its response.

examples.japanese: ⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧⟦{会計|かいけい}→会計：02536_kaikei⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{徹底的|てっていてき}→徹底的：06827_tetteiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追及|ついきゅう}し、ついに⟦{真相|しんそう}→真相：17447_shinsou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧になった。
examples.english: The journalist pursued the accounting fraud thoroughly, and the truth finally came to light.

notes:
Written with {及|きゅう} (to reach), distinguishing it from the homophone ⟦{追求|ついきゅう}→追求：14401_tsuikyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to pursue/seek — goals, ideals) and {追究|ついきゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to investigate — the truth, causes). All three are read ついきゅう but use different kanji and have distinct meanings.

KANJI DISTINCTION:
- ⟦{追及|ついきゅう}→追及：09148_tsuikyuu⟧: to press for answers, hold accountable (accountability)
- ⟦{追求|ついきゅう}→追求：14401_tsuikyuu⟧: to pursue, seek (goals, happiness, profit)
- {追究|ついきゅう}: to investigate thoroughly (causes, truth)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追及|ついきゅう}する: to hold someone accountable
- ⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追及|ついきゅう}する: to pursue wrongdoing
- ⟦{厳|きび}しく→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧{追及|ついきゅう}する: to press hard
- ⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{追及|ついきゅう}する: to question in parliament

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{追求|ついきゅう}→追求：14401_tsuikyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pursue (goals) — seeking something desirable
- {追究|ついきゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to investigate (truth) — scholarly or scientific inquiry
- ⟦{糾弾|きゅうだん}→糾弾：07890_kyuudan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to denounce — stronger, publicly condemning wrongdoing
